resolution.note: Scopes launch with collect (#326); test/hosts/systemd-scope-collect.test.ts asserts a timed-out scope leaves no unit (fails without collect). Full npm test 2026-11-07: failed krn-* before=0 after=0, exit 0.

title: Codex host tests must reset their own failed systemd scopes
body: Codex host tests leave failed krn-* systemd scopes behind: on 2026-11-07 the user manager held 371 'loaded failed' krn-* units; one npm run fast over the 19 Codex-related tests added about 5 more and 5 parallel runs added 27. Acceptance: after a full test run, `systemctl --user list-units --all 'krn-*' --state=failed --no-legend | wc -l` is unchanged from before the run (tests reset-failed their own units in cleanup), with a test that asserts this for one launched scope.

Partial fix 2026-11-07 (#326, t-0c0gcmc): scope launches now pass --collect, which unloads units that end failed (verified: a failed transient unit without --collect stays 'loaded failed', with it is gone). The failures came from launchers killed before attach ('PID vanished before we could move it', result 'resources') after the user manager stalled ~6 s. Remaining acceptance: measure failed krn-* count before/after a full test run and add the asserting test.
